text: Can be assigned tasks directly from Linear/Jira tickets
quote: Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets, implement entirely new features, repro and fix bugs, build internal tools, and more!

text: Can implement entirely new features end-to-end
quote: Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets, implement entirely new features, repro and fix bugs, build internal tools, and more!

text: Can reproduce and fix bugs autonomously
quote: Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets, implement entirely new features, repro and fix bugs, build internal tools, and more!

text: Can be used locally via a terminal CLI for quick fixes, code exploration, and interactive coding
quote: Running Devin for Terminal in your local environment for quick fixes, code exploration, and interactive coding right from the command line

text: Can hand off a longer-running task from local CLI to run in the cloud
quote: using /handoff to send longer tasks to cloud Devin

text: Can be tagged in a Slack or Teams thread to discuss and take on a bug
quote: Tagging Devin on a Slack or Teams thread about a bug you’re discussing with coworkers

text: Can be delegated a complex task via the web app and then taken over in its IDE
quote: Delegating a more complex task via the web application and taking over in Devin’s IDE once it gives you a good first draft.

text: Shows a live terminal where users can watch commands execute and view output logs
quote: Devin’s terminal, where you can watch commands being executed and view output logs. You can also copy the shell output for debugging purposes.

text: Lets a user jump in to help navigate browsing tasks via an interactive browser
quote: You can jump in to help Devin navigate through browsing tasks via the Interactive Browser.

text: Offers an API to integrate Devin into applications and automate workflows
quote: The Devin API enables you to integrate Devin into your applications, automate workflows, and build powerful tools.

text: Can create sessions on behalf of any user in an organization via an API parameter
quote: you can create sessions on behalf of any user in your organization using the create_as_user_id parameter

text: Adaptive mode automatically analyzes a prompt and routes it to the best-suited model
quote: Adaptive analyzes your prompt and routes it to the model that will deliver the best result.

text: Users can switch away from automatic routing to a specific model via a command
quote: You can switch away from Adaptive to a specific model at any time with /model.

text: MCP support lets users connect external tool servers giving the agent access to APIs, databases, and issue trackers
quote: MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets you connect external tool servers to Devin CLI, giving the agent access to APIs, databases, issue trackers, and any other service you can wrap in an MCP server.

text: MCP tool access is governed by the same permission system as built-in tools, controllable at multiple levels
quote: MCP tools are subject to the same permission system as built-in tools. You can control access at multiple levels

text: Devin CLI exposes connected MCP tools as slash commands
quote: Devin CLI exposes each one as a slash command

text: API/CLI can create sessions, manage playbooks/knowledge, and set up schedules
quote: create sessions, manage playbooks and knowledge, set up schedules, and more

text: Can explore and query generated documentation for any public or private GitHub repository
quote: These tools let you explore and query documentation for any GitHub repository (public or private with authentication)

text: Supports cron-based recurring and one-time scheduling with configurable agent selection
quote: Supports cron expressions for recurring schedules, one-time scheduling, notification preferences, and agent selection

text: Scheduling supports notification preferences for task updates
